idea-plugin.name: Git Merge Into Plus
idea-plugin.description:
Merges the current branch into a target branch of your choice and automatically switches back to the current branch when the operation finishes.

Features:
  • Searchable target-branch picker (great for repos with many branches)
  • Mark frequently used branches as favorites (star them) — they are pinned to the top
  • Remembers the last target branch per repository
  • Optional --no-ff merge commit and optional push of the target branch
  • Always restores the original (current) branch after the merge, even on failure

action.description: Merge current branch into a selected branch and stay on the current branch
